title: OMOI-IRO Show 0.1.3
description: Show file schema. Cross-reference, ID uniqueness, drop-frame and interval checks require semantic validation. 0.1.0, 0.1.1 and 0.1.2 files are read by migration (version only; 0.1.3 adds the triggered layer, keyframed effect parameters, regions custom, builtin.path, builtin.shape (with wipe and invert) and layer masks; 0.1.2 adds builtin.strobe, builtin.noise, builtin.ripple, builtin.rain, builtin.wave, builtin.orb, builtin.regions, builtin.tap_glow, builtin.cross and the optional chase reverse, ripple shape / interval trigger, wave phase and orb orbit_phase).

source.description: live_bridge: the song time from the Live Remote Script is the common clock (frame_rate / origin label the MTC output). mtc: an external MTC input.

beat_source.description: Exactly one beat input. Ableton Link Start Stop Sync is never used.

mtc_output.description: Optional MTC output generated by the app (frame rate and origin from timecode). Port selection belongs to the terminal settings, not the show.

keyframes.description: A parameter that changes over time (0.1.3): t_us ascending, 1..64 points. Values are checked like the plain value; counts, enums and booleans only step.

mask.description: 0.1.3: cut-out of the layer's own drawing (alpha multiplied). Time axis = the layer's (clip local time, or show time on a continuous layer).
